newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $120/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $120/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.

Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 119.00- 120.00. ( weighted average 119.29 ). Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 119.00- 120.00, instance 118.50. ( weighted average 119.19 ).
Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $0.50 higher. Demand and seller interest uneven, but relatively good on average. Many showlists already traded.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 72.50- 74.00, some mostly Choice to 75.00.

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 73.00-74.00, some mostly Choice to 75.00. Confirmed- 10,000 Last Week - 47,100 Last Year - 41,400 Wk To Date- 64,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 61,600 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 71,600
